Rukia, who is the Soul Reaper responsible for bringing down Metastacia while it was possessing Kaien`s body, is shocked to see her former lieutenant before her. As Aaroniero releases his Zanpakuto, Rukia struggles to find the will to defend against his attacks

episodes_data.title: The Cruel Arrancar, Ulquiorra's Provocation
episodes_data.description: Renji meets Espada Number Eight, Szayel Aporro Grantz. Renji attempts to use his Bankai but fails because of restrictions that Szayel Aporro has placed on the room they are in that limit Renji`s power. Szayel Aporro has extensive information on Renji`s abilities. He plans to capture Renji unharmed so he can conduct further research on him. Meanwhile, all of the Espada in Las Noches are informed that Rukia defeated Espada Number Nine, Aaroniero.

episodes_data.title: Szayel Aporro Laughs, The Net Trapping Renji is Complete
episodes_data.description: Ichigo and Ulquiorra begin to fight in the depths of Las Noches. Ichigo fights Ulquiorra at full power right from the start, using his Bankai and even his Hollowfication. Ulquiorra is overwhelmed by his great strength, but strategically retaliates when Ichigo removes his Hollow`s mask. Meanwhile, Renji`s Bankai is sealed away as he fights Szayel Aporro. Szayel Aporro continues to have a home-field advantage as he effortlessly blocks Renji`s attacks and calls on some of his subordinates

episodes_data.title: Shinigami and Quincy, the Battle with Madness
episodes_data.description: Lolly and Menoly are jealous that Aizen is treating Orihime well, so they go to Orihime`s room to harass her. Orihime tries to stay strong, but they are relentless. At that moment, Grimmjow comes to Orihime`s room. Meanwhile, Uryu comes to help Renji, and joins the fight against Szayel Aporro. Uryu takes advantage of an opening and pierces Szayel Aporro with Seeleschneider`s blade. Szayel Aporro collapses, but Uryu is shocked when Seeleschneider suddenly disappears.

episodes_data.title: Ishida's Strategy, the 20-second Offense and Defense
episodes_data.description: Szayel Aporro has analyzed Uryu`s and Renji`s Spiritual Pressures and has sealed away most of their abilities. The two decide to work together. Uryu says that he has a plan if Renji can stall Szayel Aporro for twenty seconds. Renji agrees and charges in, but Szayel Aporro easily deflects Zabimaru`s attacks. Meanwhile, Ichigo has been defeated by Ulquiorra and has lost consciousness.

episodes_data.title: The Murderous Intent Boils! The Joyful Grimmjow
episodes_data.description: Grimmjow takes Orihime without permission and forces her to heal Ichigo. He wants to settle things with Ichigo while he`s in his best condition. But before Ichigo`s wounds heal, Ulquiorra comes when he realizes what`s going on. Ulquiorra stops Ichigo`s healing and demands that Grimmjow hand Orihime over to him. Grimmjow refuses and attacks Ulquiorra. The clashing Spiritual Pressures of the two Espada shake Las Noches.

episodes_data.title: Desperate Effort VS Desperate Effort! The Hollowized Ichigo
episodes_data.description: A wild battle begins between Ichigo and Grimmjow. As swords and Spiritual Pressures clash, Grimmjow unleashes his strongest Cero, the Gran Rey Cero. Orihime and Nel are about to be caught in the attack, so Ichigo Hollowfies in order to save them. Grimmjow shouts for joy when faced with Ichigo`s power. He releases his Zanpakuto and shows his most powerful form. Orihime watches as the battle rages on. She becomes frightened when she compares Ichigo`s ominous Spiritual Pressure to that of her brother who became a Hollow.

episodes_data.title: The Moment of Conclusion, the End of Grimmjow
episodes_data.description: Ichigo hits Grimmjow with a mighty blow. Grimmjow is about to collapse, but he grabs Zangetsu and pulls himself up. He begins to remember his time as an Adjucha, a Hollow that has an extreme hunger for souls. They continue to obsessively devour souls until they reach the level of Gillians, and then finally they become Adjuchas. But those who become Adjuchas have the fear of degenerating. If they don`t continue to consume Hollows, they will degenerate into Gillians. Grimmjow continues to attack his fellow Hollows until he meets an interesting band of Adjuchas.

episodes_data.title: The New Captain Appears! His name is Amagai Shuusuke
episodes_data.description: A new captain joins Squad 3, taking the place of the rebel Gin Ichimaru. His name is Shusuke Amagai.

episodes_data.title: New Development, the Dangerous Transfer Student Appears!
episodes_data.description: In the middle of the night, a strange Senkaimon opens in Karakura Town, and a mysterious team of three arrives in the World of the Living.

episodes_data.title: Desperate Struggle Under the Moonlit Night, the Mysterious Assassin and Zanpakutou
episodes_data.description: A mysterious team of three transfers into Ichigo’s class. Their names are Rurichiyo Kasumiohji, Kenryu, and Enryu. Rurichiyo acts like a princess, and Kenryu and Enryu obsessively guard her surroundings.

episodes_data.title: Kenryuu, the Profusion of Blooming Crimson Flowers
episodes_data.description: Ichigo and Rukia assume the responsibility of being Rurichiyo’s bodyguard. It is Rurichiyo’s first time in the World of the Living, and she asks Ichigo to teach her about everything she sees.

episodes_data.title: Kibune Goes to War! The Violent Wind that Rages
episodes_data.description: Since welcoming Shusuke Amagai as the new captain, Squad 3 has been hard at work. But the duties Shusuke assigns them are tasks that one couldn’t imagine a Soul Reaper doing.

episodes_data.title: The Appearance of the Great Evil! The Darkness in the House of Kasumiooji
episodes_data.description: One morning, Rurichiyo suddenly disappears. Kenryu finds some indication that leads him to believe that she used the Kasumiohji Clan’s private Senkaimon to return to the Soul Society.

episodes_data.title: Captured Ichigo, Shatter the Mirror's Barrier!
episodes_data.description: Ichigo returns to the World of the Living, and he draws up a countermeasure at Kisuke Urahara’s shop. When everyone leaves Urahara’s shop, they come across Hanza Nukui, the head of an assassination squad.

episodes_data.title: The Revenging Assassin, Ichigo is Targeted
episodes_data.description: Hanza Nukui has misjudged the power of Ichigo and his friends, and has failed to assassinate Rurichiyo. He forms a unit of assassins, armed with powerful Bakkouto swords, and prepares to go back to the World of the Living.

episodes_data.title: Mystery! The Sword-Consuming Assassin
episodes_data.description: Hanza Nukui and his team of assassins, armed with Bakkoutos, arrive in the World of the Living, and they challenge Ichigo and the others to fight. Jinnai Douko appears before Rurichiyo wielding a Bakkouto.

episodes_data.title: The Reversal of Rukia, the Rampaging Blade
episodes_data.description: The respective battles of Rukia, Uryu, and Chad continue. Jinnai Douko becomes one with his Bakkouto, Retsurai, and keeps attacking. Rukia has a tough battle against Jinnai, whose whole body transforms into a weapon.

episodes_data.title: The Nightmare Which is Shown, Ichigo's Inside the Mirror
episodes_data.description: Hanza Nukui uses his Bakkouto, Saiga’s weak point, to act as a trap for Ichigo. Ichigo ends up getting caught in Hanza’s scheme, an expanse of mirrors. The mirrors take the memories of the captive and turn them into nightmares.

episodes_data.title: Confrontation?! Amagai vs. Gotei 13
episodes_data.description: At a captain’s meeting in the Soul Society, Shusuke Amagai proposes to the Thirteen Court Guard Squads that they train directly with the squads.

episodes_data.title: The Princess' Decision, the Sorrowful Bride
episodes_data.description: Ichigo and his friends have narrowly escaped Hanza Nukui’s team’s attacks. But Uryu and Chad have been inundated with the Spirit Energy of Bakkoutos, and Orihime’s healing power doesn’t seem to be working.

episodes_data.title: The 2nd Division Sorties! Ichigo is Surrounded
episodes_data.description: Rurichiyo has gone back to the Soul Society to take back control of the Kasumiohji Clan. Ichigo, Rukia, Kenryu, and Enryu follow her through the Senkaimon, and they barge in on Rurichiyo and Shu’s wedding at the Kasumiohji palace.

episodes_data.title: Amagai's True Strength, the Released Zanpakutou!
episodes_data.description: Ichigo and Rukia are being chased down by the Thirteen Court Guard Squads after sabotaging Rurichiyo and Shu’s wedding and taking Shu hostage.

episodes_data.title: The Darkness Which Moves! Kibune's True Colors
episodes_data.description: After Shu Kannogi tearfully tells Shusuke Amagai how he feels, Shusuke loses his feelings of ill will towards Ichigo and instead decides to help in their search for Rurichiyo.

episodes_data.title: Kira and Kibune, Offense and Defense of 3rd Division
episodes_data.description: The Soul Reapers stop chasing after Ichigo for the time being and focus on restoring order in the Seireitei.

episodes_data.title: Ice and Flame! Fierce Fight of Amagai vs. Hitsugaya
episodes_data.description: The intense battle between Izuru Kira and Makoto Kibune continues at Squad Three’s training facility.

episodes_data.title: Sortie Orders! Suppress the House of Kasumiooji
episodes_data.description: At the Head Captain’s command, all the Soul Reapers of the Thirteen Court Guard Squads break into the Kasumiohji Clan’s palace at once.

episodes_data.title: Ichigo Rages! The Assassin's Secret
episodes_data.description: The battle at the Kasumiohji Clan’s palace between the Thirteen Court Guard Squads and the Kasumiohji Clan’s assassins continues.

episodes_data.title: Duel! Amagai vs. Ichigo
episodes_data.description: The chaos in the Kasumiohji Clan was all a scheme formulated by Shusuke Amagai. Shusuke joined the Thirteen Court Guard Squads in order to avenge his father’s death at the hands of Head Captain Yamamoto.

episodes_data.title: The Fallen Shinigami's Pride
episodes_data.description: Shusuke Amagai wields both a Bakkouto, which seals the powers of Soul Reapers, and his Bankai, Raika Gouenkaku. Ichigo defends against Shusuke`s Bankai while Hollowfied and counterattacks with his most powerful Getsugatensho.

episodes_data.title: Hueco Mundo Chapter, Restart!
episodes_data.description: The Hueco Mundo Arc, which was put on hold for the New Captain Shusuke Amagai Arc, resumes.

episodes_data.title: Szayel Aporro's Theater
episodes_data.description: Uryu and Renji thought they had escaped, but they find themselves back at Szayelaporro`s palace.

episodes_data.title: The Secret of Nel
episodes_data.description: After finding Nel hiding in the shadow of a rock, Nnoitora tells Ichigo`s group that Nel is actually a former Espada.

episodes_data.title: The Irresistable, Puppet Show of Terror
episodes_data.description: Uryu and Renji continue fighting their clones. But no matter how many times they beat them, the clones turn back into liquid, multiply, and revive.

episodes_data.title: Neliel's Past
episodes_data.description: Nnoitora and Nelliel continue to battle. They are nearly equal in strength. The two of them used to fight side by side as fellow Espadas.

episodes_data.title: Pesche's Seriousness
episodes_data.description: Nelliel regains her memory, and Pesche and Dondochakka realize that she is going to give her all in the battle against Nnoitora. In order to go fight with Nelliel, Pesche and Dondochakka summon all their strength.

episodes_data.title: The Strongest Shinigami Army Appears
episodes_data.description: Just when Nelliel and Nnoitora`s battle is about to come to an end, something unexpected happens to Nelliel`s body. Ichigo`s group find themselves in a sticky situation yet again.

episodes_data.title: Byakuya's Bankai, the Quiet Anger
episodes_data.description: Byakuya visits Rukia, who is unconscious after being injured in the battle against Aaroniero Arruruerie. Zommari Rureaux, Espada Number 7, happens to be there, attempting to finish her off.

episodes_data.title: The Two Scientists, Mayuri's Trap
episodes_data.description: Zommari`s technique, "Amor," takes control over anything its eyes gaze upon. He uses this power to control Rukia`s body and use her as a shield.

episodes_data.title: The Resurrecting Szayel Aporro
episodes_data.description: Szayelaporro is exasperated when his powers don`t work at all against Mayuri Kurotsuchi, and he ends up being enveloped by Mayuri`s Konjiki Ashisogijizo. Just then, something happens to Nemu, who was being held hostage.

episodes_data.title: Nnoitra is Cut Down
episodes_data.description: Szayelaporro used his prisoner Nemu as a medium to come back to life. However, Nemu`s body is permeated with the new medicine that Mayuri developed. Szayelaporro experiences the dreadful effects of the medicine himself.

episodes_data.title: Nnoitra Releases! The Multiplying Arms
episodes_data.description: Kenpachi goes after Nnoitora`s eye and pierces his eye patch, but the eye patch was hiding a dreadful secret.

episodes_data.title: Fierce Fighting Conclusion! Who's the Strongest
episodes_data.description: When Kenpachi`s eye patch comes off, releasing his Spiritual Pressure and true strength, Nnoitora invokes his sword attack, Santa Teresa.

episodes_data.title: Aizen vs. Shinigami
episodes_data.description: Nnoitora has never shown any mercy to his opponents, and he has always finished them off. Nnoitora`s reason for fighting has always been purely to fight. He has been fighting and becoming stronger, hoping to someday die in battle.

episodes_data.title: Ichigo's Seppuku Persuasion Strategy
episodes_data.description: Rurichiyo Kasumiohji, who supposedly became the head of the family, goes off to the World of the Living by herself after getting in a fight with Kenryu.

episodes_data.title: Thump! The Football Tournament of Hollows
episodes_data.description: Rurichiyo and Kenryu`s fight was over how to revitalize the Kasumiohji Clan. Rurichiyo is concerned about the low spirits of her people, and she wants to host a soccer tournament.

episodes_data.title: The Past Chapter Begins! The Truth from 110 Years Ago
episodes_data.description: In the Soul Society 110 years ago, the Thirteen Court Guard Squads are made up of unfamiliar faces. The captain of Squad Five is the masked Visored, Shinji Hirako who currently resides in the World of the Living.

episodes_data.title: 12th Division's New Captain, Urahara Kisuke
episodes_data.description: Kisuke Urahara replaces the newly promoted Kirio Hikifune as captain of Squad Twelve. Hiyori Sarugaki, lieutenant of Squad Twelve, cannot hide her dissatisfaction with the new captain.

episodes_data.title: Aizen and the Boy Genius
episodes_data.description: Kisuke takes Hiyori to the Special underground Confinement Unit inside the Squad Two barracks. Nicknamed the Maggot`s Nest, this place imprisons enlisted Thirteen Court Guard Squad members whose beliefs or actions have been deemed dangerous.

episodes_data.title: Muguruma's 9th Division, Sets Out
episodes_data.description: Nine years have passed since Kisuke Urahara was appointed captain of Squad Twelve. Bizarre deaths start to occur in the Rukon District where people disappear, leaving only their clothes behind.

episodes_data.title: Hiyori Dies? The Beginning of Tragedy
episodes_data.description: Kensei Muguruma`s and Mashiro Kuna`s Spiritual Pressure disappears. The Seireitei deems this a dire situation. Kisuke Urahara, who sent Hiyori to Squad Nine, volunteers to go to the scene of their disappearance.

episodes_data.title: Betrayal! Aizen's Secret Maneuvers
episodes_data.description: At Squad Nine`s camp, Shinji Hirako and the others run into Kensei Muguruma, who is donning a strange mask. Kensei starts to attack them, and he is too powerful to stop even with all of them combined.

episodes_data.title: Rescue Hirako! Aizen vs. Urahara
episodes_data.description: Sosuke Aizen suddenly appears in front of Shinji Hirako and the others. He draws his sword on Shinji, who is agonized by his Hollow transformation and cannot move his body at will.

episodes_data.title: The Karakurizer is Born
episodes_data.description: Ichigo and his friends leave Karakura Town with the intent of bringing Orihime back, and they continue fighting in Hueco Mundo. Nevertheless, Hollows continue to appear in the World of the Living.

episodes_data.title: Karakuraizer's Last Day
episodes_data.description: Kisuke Urahara has forced Kon to transform into Konso Cop Karakurizer. As Karakurizer, Kon has some powerful allies.

episodes_data.title: Defend Karakura Town! Entire Appearance of the Shinigami
episodes_data.description: Sosuke Aizen brings Kaname Tosen, Gin Ichimaru, and the Espadas Stark, Barragan, and Halibel to the World of the Living on a mission to destroy Karakura Town. The Espadas stand before the Thirteen Court Guard Squads.

episodes_data.title: Elite! The Four Shinigami
episodes_data.description: The Head Captain expected the battle to take place in Karakura Town, so he fights to keep it from being destroyed. He places pillars in four corners of the town to switch the real Karakura Town with a replica that was made in the Soul Society.

episodes_data.title: Beautiful Warrior Charlotte
episodes_data.description: Shuhei, Ikkaku, Yumichika, and Izuru start fighting against the Fracci贸nes that Barragan deployed.

episodes_data.title: Kira, the Battle Within Despair
episodes_data.description: Yumichika is trapped inside Chuhlhourne’s briar of darkness. Learning he cannot be seen from the outside world, Yumichika unveils his Zanpakuto’s true power.

episodes_data.title: Hisagi's Shikai! The Name is...
episodes_data.description: Shuhei Hisagi battles Findorr Calius, who has increased his strength level equal to that of a squad lieutenant by shattering his own mask. Shuhei, overwhelmed by the enemy’s power, is forced to stay on the defensive.

episodes_data.title: Ikkaku Falls! The Shinigami's Crisis
episodes_data.description: Shuhei, Izuru, Yumichika, and Ikkaku fight to guard the four pillars used to switch the real Karakura Town with a fake one.

episodes_data.title: The Full Showdown! Shinigami vs. Espada
episodes_data.description: The Soul Reapers succeed in defending the four pillars from being destroyed, preventing the real Karakura Town from returning to the World of the Living.

episodes_data.title: The Most Evil Tag!? Soi Fon & Oomaeda
episodes_data.description: Soi Fon and Marechiyo Omaeda are to take on Ggio and Nirgge. Soi Fon confidently goes after Ggio, but Ggio puts up a good fight.

episodes_data.title: A Miraculous Body! Ggio Releases
episodes_data.description: Ggio, who released his Hollow power, is overpowering Soi Fon. Marechiyo Omaeda realizes that Soi Fon is in a dire situation and comes to help her.

episodes_data.title: 3 vs. 1 Battle! Rangiku's Crisis
episodes_data.description: Rangiku battles Halibel’s three Fracciónes, Apache, Mila Rose, and Sun-Sun. She attacks with her Haineko, but even that is not very effective against the three opponents.

episodes_data.title: All Vice-Captains Annihilated! The Terrifying Demonic Beast
episodes_data.description: Apache, Mila Rose, and Sun-Sun release their Resurrección forms. In addition, they combine their left arms to create a mysterious monster called Ayon.

episodes_data.title: Fierce Fighting Concludes? Towards a New Battle!
episodes_data.description: The Soul Reapers are defeated one after another at the hands of Ayon. Seeing this, Head Captain Genryusai Yamamoto decides to get involved.

episodes_data.title: Wonderful Error
episodes_data.description: Mizuiro starts at Karakura First High School without any great expectations or ambitions.

episodes_data.title: Summer! Sea! Swimsuit Festival!!
episodes_data.description: Rangiku and the members of the Women’s Soul Reaper Association take a relaxing trip to a beach in the World of the Living. All the women are excited about wearing bathing suits that they have picked out for the occasion.

episodes_data.title: The Rug Shinigami is Born!
episodes_data.description: Ikkaku and Yumichika are sent after a Hollow that ran away to the World of the Living. They have no prearranged lodging, so they decide to stay at the Asano family house.

episodes_data.title: The Materialization of Zanpakutou
episodes_data.description: A mysterious man who calls himself "Muramasa" appears in the Seireitei to declare war against the Soul Reapers. Using his powers, Muramasa gives physical form to the Zanpakuto and liberates them from the captains and lieutenants of the 13 Court Guard Squads.

episodes_data.title: Byakuya, Disappearing With the Cherry Blossoms
episodes_data.description: Having sustained severe injuries in battle, Rukia escapes to the World of the Living and is saved by Ichigo. A mysterious woman then arrives through the Senkaimon and proceeds to attack the two using the same Zanpakuto as Rukia.

episodes_data.title: Sode no Shirayuki vs. Rukia! The Delusion of the Heart
episodes_data.description: After hearing that Byakuya has gone missing, Rukia returns to the Seireitei to search for her brother and in the process comes across Sodenoshirayuki.

episodes_data.title: Zangetsu Becomes an Enemy
episodes_data.description: Muramasa appears before Ichigo and explains how he freed the Zanpakuto from the Soul Reapers, as well as gave them a physical form to exist.

episodes_data.title: Renji Surprised?! The Two Zabimaru
episodes_data.description: The Zanpakuto rebellion has left the Seireitei in a state of destruction with many Soul Reapers still missing, including Squad Six captain Byakuya Kuchiki.

episodes_data.title: Clash! Hisagi vs. Kazeshini
episodes_data.description: Inside Ichigo`s mind, Muramasa meets Hollow Ichigo. Taking an interest in him, Muramasa attempts to manifest Hollow Ichigo like he did with Zangetsu, only to discover that his spell does not work on Hollow Ichigo.

episodes_data.title: Release! The New Getsuga Tenshou
episodes_data.description: Ichigo has regained his Shikai and battles Muramasa. But Zangetsu, who has sided with Muramasa, steps in to fight Ichigo.

episodes_data.title: Soi Fon, Surrounding the Zanpakutou
episodes_data.description: Ichigo`s and Renji`s victories against their own Zanpakuto has proven that a Soul Reaper can reclaim his Zanpakuto by defeating it in battle.

episodes_data.title: Friendship? Hatred? Haineko & Tobiume
episodes_data.description: Haineko and Tobiume, two Zanpakuto who do not get along, are walking through the woods when they spot Ichigo, who is in pursuit of Senbonzakura and Byakuya.

episodes_data.title: The Awakening Hyourinmaru!
episodes_data.description: The battle of Rangiku and Momo versus Haineko and Tobiume heats up, as both sides try to outsmart their opponents. Elsewhere, captain Toshiro Hitsugaya has located his Zanpakuto Hyorinmaru.

episodes_data.title: Byakuya's Betrayal
episodes_data.description: Results from Mayuri Kurotsuchi`s experiment using Marechiyo Omaeda`s Gegetsuburi show that a manifested Zanpakuto cannot revert to its original sword state when defeated by someone other than its master.

episodes_data.title: For the Sake of Pride! Byakuya vs. Renji
episodes_data.description: The Thirteen Court Guard Squads, particularly Renji and Rukia, are shocked by the news of Byakuya now supposedly working with Muramasa. Meanwhile, inside Muramasa`s hideout, the Zanpakuto cannot hide their discomfort over having Byakuya join them.

episodes_data.title: Shinigami and Zanpakutou, Total Sortie
episodes_data.description: At the Squad Six Barracks, Renji and Rukia are determined to know why Byakuya has betrayed the Soul Society to work with Muramasa. Their conversation is cut short by the arrival of the manifested Zanpakuto.

episodes_data.title: One-to-One Fight! Ichigo vs. Senbonzakura
episodes_data.description: The Soul Reapers find themselves in a tough battle against the manifested Zanpakuto, including Ichigo who is struggling against Senbonzakura.

episodes_data.title: The Long Awaited... Kenpachi Appears!
episodes_data.description: The battle between Soul Reapers and Zanpakuto heats up as Kenpachi joins in the fight. Kenpachi easily overwhelms the Zanpakuto with his incredible Spirit Energy and then goes off to challenge Byakuya.

episodes_data.title: Pursue Byakuya! The Confused Gotei Divisions
episodes_data.description: Ichigo, Renji, Rukia, and Izuru collapse after being exposed to Konjiki Ashisogijizo`s poison. Konjiki Ashisogijizo then seeks for its next prey but is stopped by Yachiru Kusajishi.

episodes_data.title: Special Mission! Rescue Captain-Commander Yamamoto!
episodes_data.description: Yoruichi has located Muramasa`s hideout where Head Captain Yamamoto is being held. A team comprised of Ichigo, Shunsui, Jushiro, Kenpachi, and Yoruichi sets out to rescue the Head Captain, but the group soon encounters the Zanpakuto who were anticipating their arrival.

episodes_data.title: Deceived Shinigami! The World Collapse Crisis
episodes_data.description: Ichigo battles Muramasa in order to save Head Captain Yamamoto from captivity. Meanwhile, Yoruichi, Shunsui, and Jushiro notice that the Zanpakuto are trying to prevent them from reaching Ichigo, and quickly realize that he was the key to Muramasa`s plan all along.

episodes_data.title: Dragon of Ice and Dragon of Flame! The Strongest Showdown!
episodes_data.description: Muramasa`s true objective is revealed to be in Karakura Town. Ichigo and the other Soul Reapers try to go after Muramasa, but the manifested Zanpakuto of Genryusai`s Ryujinjakka stands in their way.

episodes_data.title: Senbonzakura's Bankai! Offense and Defense of the Living World
episodes_data.description: Uryu, Chad, and Orihime confront Muramasa who has entered the World of the Living. Using teamwork, Uryu and Chad at first appear to gain the upper hand in battle, when Senbonzakura appears to assist Muramasa.

episodes_data.title: That Man, For the Sake of the Kuchiki
episodes_data.description: Centuries ago, Ginrei Kuchiki, Byakuya Kuchiki`s grandfather, and his son-in-law Koga Kuchiki were assigned to bring down the rebel forces threatening the Seireitei. With his Zanpakuto Muramasa`s power, Koga wipes out the renegade Soul Reapers one after another, and soon his strength becomes known throughout the Soul Society. Yet Koga himself was frustrated by the fact that his father-in-law Ginrei did not seem to acknowledge his accomplishments.

episodes_data.title: Dark History! The Worst Shinigami is Born
episodes_data.description: Koga Kuchiki escapes his confinement and in the process, kills the Soul Reapers who framed him. Although Ginrei sympathizes with his son-in-law`s situation, he reprimands Koga for his rash actions. Enraged, Koga severs his ties with the Kuchiki clan and begins killing Soul Reapers and innocent people.

episodes_data.title: Byakuya, the Truth Behind his Betrayal
episodes_data.description: To uphold the honor of his family, Byakuya Kuchiki fights the resurrected Koga Kuchiki. Meanwhile, the despair of being abandoned by Koga takes its toll on Muramasa`s body.

episodes_data.title: Muramasa's True Identity Revealed
episodes_data.description: Koga`s betrayal causes Muramasa to lose control over all of the Hollows he absorbed to sustain himself. To make matters worse, his immense Spiritual Pressure begins to attract other Hollows to Karakura Town. As Ichigo, Uryu, Chad, Orihime, and Rukia work together to deal with the situation, Muramasa fires a massive Cero towards them.

episodes_data.title: Byakuya and Renji, the 6th Division Returns
episodes_data.description: Uryu and the others attempt to save Ichigo, who has been engulfed by Muramasa, but with little success. Meanwhile, the Soul Reapers of the Thirteen Court Guard Squads team up with their own Zanpakuto to fight the Hollows that have appeared in the World of the Living.

episodes_data.title: Final Chapter Zanpakuto Unknown Tales
episodes_data.description: Inside Muramasa`s mind, Ichigo clashes blades with Muramasa. As Muramasa`s body and mind reach their limits, he begins to transform into a Hollow. With little time remaining, Ichigo and Muramasa decide to settle their score once and for all.

episodes_data.title: Byakuya's Anger! The Kuchiki Family Collapses
episodes_data.description: With the defeat of Muramasa, peace has returned to the Soul Society. Renji, Rukia, and the other Soul Reapers are having a good time at the Kuchiki mansion`s party, when the place is suddenly attacked by two unknown beings. Having left her Zanpakuto behind, Rukia falls into danger when, to her surprise, the manifested Sodenoshirayuki comes to her rescue.

episodes_data.title: A New Enemy! The True Nature of the Beast Swords
episodes_data.description: The assailants who attacked the Kuchiki mansion are identified as "Sword Beasts," manifested Zanpakuto of Soul Reapers who lost their lives during the battle with Muramasa. Due to the potential danger, an order is issued throughout the Soul Society to hunt down all remaining Sword Beasts, including ones who have escaped into the World of the Living. Toshiro, Hyorinmaru, Rangiku, and Haineko go after a Sword Beast who is in the World of the Living searching for its master.

episodes_data.title: Stray Snake, Tortured Monkey
episodes_data.description: Renji and Zabimaru (Monkey and Snake) come to the World of the Living to go after a Sword Beast. However, Snake is too distracted by his surroundings, and as a result lets the Sword Beast escape. After being scolded by Renji and Monkey, a frustrated Snake decides he wants to be his own man and runs off.

episodes_data.title: Terror! The Monster That Lurks Underground
episodes_data.description: Isane and Hanataro are troubled by the recent reports of someone stealing food from the Squad Four barracks. Evidence shows that the thief is hiding in an underground waterway, and so a team comprised of Hanataro, Nanao, Ikkaku, and Hozukimaru is sent down for investigation.

episodes_data.title: Conclusion?! Hisagi vs. Kazeshini
episodes_data.description: Following Muramasa`s defeat, most of the Zanpakuto have reconciled and returned to their masters, except for Kazeshini, who is still out to kill his former master Shuhei Hisagi. When Kazeshini goes into the Rukon District in the hopes of finding Shuhei, he instead comes across an infant who just lost his father to a Sword Beast. To Kazeshini`s annoyance, the infant has taken a liking to the rogue Zanpakuto and now refuses to leave his side.

episodes_data.title: The Person with the Unknown Ability! Orihime is Targeted
episodes_data.description: Karakura Town has been experiencing a string of assaults, and the victims have all been reported to be high school girls carrying a pink bear charm. Meanwhile, a new girl transfers into Orihime`s class and introduces herself as Kyoko Haida. When Orihime accidentally exposes her powers before Kyoko, the new girl takes an interest in her, claiming she is worthy to become her friend.

episodes_data.title: The Tragic Sword Fiend! Haineko Cries!
episodes_data.description: During a mission to hunt down the Sword Beasts, Haineko comes across a wounded Sword Beast called Narunosuke and, to her surprise, falls in love with the handsome enemy before her. Believing that Narunosuke is different from other Sword Beasts, Haineko goes against her orders and decides to look after him.

episodes_data.title: Confinement!? Senbonzakura and Zabimaru
episodes_data.description: Renji`s Zanpakuto Zabimaru, consisting of Monkey and Snake, are irritated over the fact that Byakuya`s Senbonzakura is taking all the credit for their work. Later, a small accident leads to the three Zanpakuto becoming trapped inside the Department of Research and Development`s facility. As they try to find a means to escape, the two Zabimarus find Senbonzakura to be more troublesome than either of them had anticipated.

episodes_data.title: Women's Fight? Katenkyoukotsu vs Nanao!
episodes_data.description: Lieutenant Nanao Ise is paired up with Katenkyokotsu Wakizashi, the shorter of Captain Kyoraku`s two swords, to hunt for Sword Beasts. But Nanao finds Wakizashi`s malicious and distrustful nature to be quite difficult to work with.

episodes_data.title: Progress!? The Last Sword Fiend Threat!
episodes_data.description: The Zanpakuto notice the remaining Sword Beasts acting strangely and realize it to be the work of Kirikaze, a Sword Beast capable of robbing Spirit Energy from others. With their time to manifest as physical entities reaching its limits, the Zanpakuto are determined to carry out their last mission to defeat Kirikaze.

episodes_data.title: Ichigo Vs Ulquiorra, Restart!
episodes_data.description: Aizen leads Tosen, Gin, and the Espadas as they invade the World of the Living. Aizen’s real objective is to annihilate Karakura Town to create Ouken, the royal key and take the Soul Society by storm. The Soul Reapers anticipate this and prepare for battle. Meanwhile, Ichigo gets on his way to save Orihime from the Fifth Tower where she is being held captive. And then, Ichigo and Ulquiorra’s fated showdown finally begins!

episodes_data.title: Connected Hearts! The Left Fist Prepared for Death!
episodes_data.description: Below the Fifth Tower, Sado and Renji battle it out with a giant Hollow. But then, the sandman Batticaloa arrives to the scene. Batticaloa’s body is made of sand, so Sado and Renji have a hard time inflicting any damage on him. And Rukia, whose ice-snow Zanpakuto is the sole weapon that can contend with Batticaloa, is struggling in another battle against Rudobon. Meanwhile, Ichigo and Ulquiorra are still battling when Ichigo learns that Orihime has already been converted to Ulquiorra’s side. Ichigo pretends it doesn’t concern him, but he can’t hide his distress.

episodes_data.title: Jealousy and Hatred... Orihime's Dilemma
episodes_data.description: While Orihime is watching Ichigo and Ulquiorra’s battle from the sidelines, Loly and Menoly appear before her. They learned that Orihime is no longer of any use to Aizen, and they want to seize this opportunity to defeat her. Orihime has no means to fight back, and she gets hurt left and right. When Ichigo notices this, he tries to go rescue her, but Ulquiorra keeps getting in his way, and he is unable to get anywhere near Orihime. Amidst the chaos, a new enemy breaks through the floor of the Fifth Tower and appears before Ichigo and the others. The new enemy is none other than Yammy who came to assist Ulquiorra.

episodes_data.title: Ichigo and Uryuu, Back to Back Bonds!
episodes_data.description: Uryu rushes to stop Yammy from attacking Orihime. Ichigo is surprised, but Uryu charges at Yammy without hesitation. Uryu notices that Ichigo, concerned about Orihime, was not using the power of his Hollowfication, and Uryu was trying to get the fight with Yammy over with as quickly as possible. However, Yammy’s body is tough, and every attack from Ginreikojaku’s arrow and Seeleschneider is repelled. Yammy triumphantly brings out a giant Cero on them. Just when they thought it couldn’t get any worse…

episodes_data.title: Beginning of Despair... Ichigo, the Unreachable Blade
episodes_data.description: Ulquiorra’s sword release, Murcielago, is too strong for Ichigo and every swift attack further injures him. Even when he fires Getsugatensho with all of his remaining power, Ichigo is unable to wound Ulquiorra. In spite of that, Ichigo continues to attack Ulquiorra in order to save Orihime and go back with his friends. But Ulquiorra tries to show off his Resurreccion Segunda Etapa.  Meanwhile, Orihime and Uryu are worried about Ichigo as they head to the top of the dome…

episodes_data.title: Ichigo Dies! Orihime, the Cry of Sorrow!
episodes_data.description: When Orihime and Uryu make it to the top of the dome, they see Ichigo collapsed in front of Ulquiorra. Orihime’s reaction is to rush over to Ichigo, but Ulquiorra tells her that it’s no use. Just then, Uryu hits Ulquiorra with his arrow. But like all of Ichigo’s attacks, Uryu’s arrow is ineffective against Ulquiorra. Ulquiorra attacks back and Uryu is no longer able to even draw his bow. Distressed by the situation, Orihime calls out to the immobile Ichigo for help. Then something happens to Ichigo’s body….

episodes_data.title: Ichigo Vs Ulquiorra, Conclusion!
episodes_data.description: Rukia, Renji, and Sado are battling Rudobon and the soldiers he created. But then, another enemy appears before them. It is Yammy, who fell off of the Fifth Tower. The three of them are surprised that Yammy has transformed into a giant. In the meantime, on top of the dome, a Hollowfied Ichigo is fighting Ulquiorra. When Uryu tries to stop Ichigo…

episodes_data.title: Fury of a Shark! Halibel Releases
episodes_data.description: Rukia, Renji, and Sado struggle against the giant Yammy. However, when they see Yammy’s tattoo of the number “10”, they realize that he is weaker than the Espadas they’ve fought in the past. Each one of them tries to go after Yammy, but Yammy releases  his sword, Ira , which overwhelms them. Meanwhile, in Karakura Town, the battle between the Soul Reapers and the Espada, led by Aizen, intensifies. Halibel attacks Hitsugaya, who achieves Bankai and counterattacks, but…

episodes_data.title: Hitsugaya, the Suicidal Frozen Heavens Hundred Flowers Funeral!
episodes_data.description: Hitsugaya is doing everything he can to counter Halibel’s sword release, Tiburon. Halibel says she will win against Hitsugaya to avenge her Fracciónes. She melts the ice with Hirviendo and drives Hitsugaya into a corner. Hitsugaya counters by turning Halibel’s water attack into ice with his Zanpakuto, Hyorinmaru, but Halibel has other tricks up her sleeve…

episodes_data.title: The Approaching Breath of Death... the King Who Rules Over Death!
episodes_data.description: While Hitsugaya and Halibel’s battle looks to be coming to a close, Omaeda and Soi Fon fight against Barragan. Just when Soi Fon is about to attack Barragan, Soi Fon suddenly becomes sluggish. Soi Fon is baffled, and Barragan tells her that he has the power to age people. Barragan only has to will old age upon his opponent and touch that person for the opponent to immediately grow old and die. Soi Fon now understands the severity of this power, but she has already been touched by Barragan…

episodes_data.title: One Hit Kill! Soi Fon, Bankai!
episodes_data.description: The battle between the Soul Reapers and the Espada becomes more and more tense. Soi Fon and Omaeda find themselves in a bad situation against Barragan’s Respira. They can’t even counterattack Respira because they can’t get anywhere near it. Then, Soi Fon goes off somewhere, leaving Omaeda to fight Barragan alone. Omaeda attacks with Gegetsuburi, but Barragan destroys it easily with Respira. Just when Omaeda is backed into a corner, Soi Fon arrives, having released her Bankai…

episodes_data.title: Climax! Kyouraku Vs Starrk!
episodes_data.description: Kyoraku and Stark are both fighting defensively in their battle. But Stark’s expression changes when he spots Hitsugaya and Soi Fon’s Bankai. Kyoraku leaves his haori with Ukitake to confront Stark. Stark calls Lilinette over, and tells everyone that the two of them used to be one person. Stark then releases his Resurrección and takes on the form of Los Lobos. Kyoraku achieves Shikai and they continue to fight for real!

episodes_data.title: The Nightmare Returns... Revival of the Espada
episodes_data.description: Kyoraku is in a pinch, and Ukitake, who had been watching the battle, steps in. Ukitake fires Cero at Stark, even though it is a technique that Soul Reapers shouldn’t be able to use. Stark is surprised, but he quickly recovers from the shock and shoots something back at him. Then, all of a sudden, Garganta starts to open to reveal the creepy Wonderweiss and Fura. All of the Soul Reapers are exhausted from battling, and they are in no state to face a new opponent…

episodes_data.title: Hirako and Aizen... the Reunion of Fate!
episodes_data.description: The Soul Reapers find themselves in hot water against Fura and Wonderweiss when the Visoreds, led by Shinji Hirako, make their appearance. Used in Aizen’s Hollowfication experiment 101 years ago, the Visoreds have since lived in hiding in the World of the Living. Believing that now is the time to defeat Aizen, the Visoreds have set foot on the battlefield.  Recognizing familiar faces, both Visoreds and Soul Reapers exchange words with one another. Wonderweiss disrupts the scene by signaling Fura to release hordes of Menos…

episodes_data.title: Hisagi and Tousen, the Moment of Parting
episodes_data.description: Hisagi joins Komamura to battle Tosen in hopes of bringing his former captain back to his senses. Meanwhile the other Soul Reapers form an uneasy alliance with the Visoreds: Lisa, Hiyori, and Hitsugaya take on Halibel. Love and Rose take on Stark. Hachi, Omaeda, and Soi Fon take on Barragan. The battle against the Espada resumes!

episodes_data.title: Crown of Lies, Baragan's Grudge
episodes_data.description: Barragan appears to be defeated by the combined efforts of Hachigen and Soi Fon. But the two are shocked to find Barragan forcing open Hachigen’s Shiju Saimon barrier. As king of Hueco Mundo, Barragan is determined to show the world his absolute strength and power. His reason originates as far back to when he once reigned over his subjects in Las Noches. Having no enemies to conquer, Barragan would pit his subjects against one another to fight off his boredom. That was when Aizen arrived in Hueco Mundo.

episodes_data.title: Power of the Soul! The Wolves, Attack!
episodes_data.description: Stark shows no sign of getting serious in his battle against Love and Rose. Running out of patience, Lilinette begins to mindlessly fire at the two Visoreds without Stark’s permission. But her attacks prove to be ineffective against the two, and she is gradually cornered by the pair’s fine team play. Finally, Love hits Stark with his Zanpakuto attack, and the Espada is thrown into a sea of flames.

episodes_data.title: Starrk, the Lone Battle
episodes_data.description: Stark splits his own soul and shapes it into packs of wolves and launches them against Love and Rose. Preparing to deliver the finishing blow, Stark is caught off guard by Shunsui, who suddenly appears out of Stark’s shadow. Despite his best efforts to dodge the attacks, Stark is gradually weakened. Just then the wolves, headed by Lilinette, swarm over Shunsui. He brushes them off, and the wolves disappear. Stark calls out for Lilinette but hears no reply.

episodes_data.title: Chain of Sacrifice, Harribel's Past
episodes_data.description: Las Noches. Long ago, Apache, at the time still an Adjucha-class Hollow, was hunted by other Hollows when Halibel saved her life. Apache soon joins Halibel’s group consisting of Sun-Sun and Mila Rose. As they spend more time together, Apache notices Halibel does not devour the enemies she defeats. When questioned, Halibel responds that she does not wish to become stronger by sacrificing others.

episodes_data.title: The Hundred-Year Grudge! Hiyori's Revenge
episodes_data.description: With the Espada gone, the Visoreds are now able to confront Aizen. Having been unwilling test subjects in Aizen’s past experiment, the Visoreds make no effort to hide their hatred toward the man who destroyed their lives. Hiyori, unable hold in her anger, is the first to attack Aizen with her blade. Meanwhile, Chad, Renji, and Rukia continue their fight against Yammy in Hueco Mundo.

episodes_data.title: Ichigo's Return! Protect Karakura Town
episodes_data.description: Ichigo goes up against Yammy. Rukia notices that Ichigo is acting strange following his battle with Ulquiorra and shows her concern for him. Ichigo is also shaken up by the fact that his Hollowfication now feels different. But, unable to forgive Yammy for labeling Ulquiorra and Grimmjow as trash, Ichigo makes another attempt at his Hollowfication.

episodes_data.title: Side Story! Ichigo and the Magic Lamp
episodes_data.description: Ichigo wakes up to find himself in the middle of a desert. Sitting next to a confused Ichigo are Uryu, Orihime, and Chad, all dressed in an Arabian style. Introducing themselves as “Urio,” “Ori Mei,” and “Chaido,” the three explain that they are in search of a treasure called the “Snow Crystal.”

episodes_data.title: The Final Trump Card! Ichigo, Towards the Decisive Battle
episodes_data.description: Kenpachi overcomes Yammy’s monstrous size and tough exterior to land a clean blow against the Espada. Meanwhile, Ichigo uses Garganta to return to the World of the Living. On the way, Captain Unohana explains to Ichigo about Aizen’s power of “Complete Hypnosis.” She then reveals that Ichigo is the key to defeating Aizen.

episodes_data.title: Byakuya vs. Kenpachi?! The Melee Commences
episodes_data.description: As he holds a dying Hiyori, an enraged Hirako readies himself to confront Aizen in battle. Meanwhile, Hisagi and Komamura battle Tosen in a desperate attempt to bring their former ally back to his senses. But Tosen, who believes he follows a just path, ignores their plea and attacks them.

episodes_data.title: For the Sake of Justice?! The Man Who Deserted the Shinigami
episodes_data.description: Komamura performs his Bankai, Kokujo Tengen Myo-oh, to subdue Tosen. However, Tosen has already deduced the weakness of Komamura’s Bankai from years of working closely together. Despite the damage received, Komamura refuses to give up on his former friend, throwing out the question of why Tosen chose to become a Soul Reaper in the first place.

episodes_data.title: Desperate Struggle with Aizen! Hirako, Shikai!
episodes_data.description: Tosen is now able to see in his Ressureccion form. But Komamura states that in exchange for his vision, Tosen has now blinded his own heart. Unable to bring himself to kill the man he wanted to save, Komamura falls before Tosen’s attack. Meanwhile, Hirako prepares to use his Shikai, Sakanade, against Aizen.

episodes_data.title: All Out War! Aizen vs. Shinigami!
episodes_data.description: Ichigo has returned to the World of the Living to battle Aizen. After an unsuccessful first attack, Ichigo Hollowfies to deliver his Getsugatensho against Aizen, but that too proves ineffective. Witnessing the immense power Aizen holds, Ichigo begins to lose his will to fight, when the Thirteen Court Guard Squads stand up to support him.

episodes_data.title: Hitsugaya, Enraged! Blade of Hatred!
episodes_data.description: The Thirteen Court Guard Squads and Visoreds launch a full-scale attack against Aizen. But Aizen makes quick work of their combined efforts. Just when all hope is thought to be lost, Hirako uses his Zanpakuto’s power to draw away Aizen’s attention, giving way for Hitsugaya to deliver the killing blow.

episodes_data.title: The Sealed Genryuusai!
episodes_data.description: Head Captain Genryusai Yamamoto of the Thirteen Court Guard Squads steps in to battle Aizen. Genryusai’s attempt to incinerate Aizen in a blazing inferno is thwarted by Wonderweiss, whose Ressureccion form extinguishes the flames. Wonderweiss is revealed to be a Mod Arrancar created by Aizen for the sole purpose of sealing away Genryusai’s zanpakuto, Ryujinjakka.

episodes_data.title: It's All a Trap... Engineered Bonds!
episodes_data.description: Ichigo succeeds in wounding Aizen with his Hollowfied Getsugatensho attack. But to his surprise, the Hogyoku instantly heals Aizen’s wound. Aizen then reveals an even more shocking truth to Ichigo.

episodes_data.title: The Shocking Truth...The Mysterious Power Within Ichigo!
episodes_data.description: Aizen’s revelation that Ichigo is his greatest research subject throws Ichigo into a state of shock. But before Aizen can reveal Ichigo’s most startling secret he is interrupted by an unexpected person arriving on the scene.

episodes_data.title: The Extending Blade?! Ichigo vs. Gin!
episodes_data.description: As they cross blades, Gin asks Ichigo if he recalls their last encounter, to which Ichigo responds he does not remember Gin’s “heart” being present back then. Ichigo’s answer prompts Gin to display his Bankai and its incredible power. Meanwhile, Isshin notices a change occurring within Aizen.

episodes_data.title: Film! Festival! Shinigami Film Festival!
episodes_data.description: A Seireitei International Film Festival is to be held in the Soul Society, and Nanao recruits Ichigo and his friends to cooperate with the filming. The crew consists of Rukia in the lead role, Renji as the director, Uryu as the costume designer, with Rangiku, Orihime, and Chad as supporting cast members. Will these guys really be able complete the film and win the award for best film?!

episodes_data.title: Theatre Opening Commemoration! Hell Chapter: Prologue
episodes_data.description: While visiting the World of the Living, Rukia comes across Kurumadani, the current Soul Reaper stationed in Karakura Town, being attacked by a mysterious masked man. To her surprise, the masked man reveals himself as Shrieker, the Hollow previously defeated and sent to hell by Rukia and Chad.

episodes_data.title: Urahara Appears! Stop Aizen!
episodes_data.description: Kisuke Urahara steps onto the battlefield as Aizen, fused with the Hogyoku, begins his transformation. Urahara’s Kido attack appears ineffective against Aizen, who claims he has complete control over the Hogyoku. But Urahara’s true goal was to turn Aizen’s own spirit energy against himself.

episodes_data.title: Ichigo Loses His Fighting Spirit!? Gin's Expectation!
episodes_data.description: Ichigo finds himself cornered against Gin’s Bankai. But to Ichigo’s surprise, Gin advises him to run from this battle. Meanwhile, Urahara, Yoruichi, and Isshin fight Aizen in a three-on-one battle. But none of their attacks appear to work against Aizen.

episodes_data.title: The Final Getsuga Tenshou!? Ichigo's Training!
episodes_data.description: While going after Aizen, who has left for Karakura Town, Ichigo and Isshin arrive in the Precipice World, a place where time flows two thousand times slower than the outside world. Isshin decides to use this opportunity to have Ichigo acquire the “Final Getsugatensho,” which could defeat Aizen. Meanwhile, at the Karakura Town relocated to the Soul Society, Keigo and Tatsuki wake up to realize something terrible is happening to their town.

episodes_data.title: Real World and Shinigami! The New Year Special!
episodes_data.description: The Women’s Soul Reaper Association is hosting a New Year’s party in the Soul Society, when Hitsugaya and the other male Soul Reapers come crashing in. Meanwhile in the World of the Living, everyone is spending New Year’s with their families. Orihime, who has no family, spends her time alone, when Rukia and Renji come by to say their New Year’s greeting.

episodes_data.title: Another Side Story! This Time the Enemy Is a Monster!?
episodes_data.description: Two monster hunters arrive at an old castle where Franken Ichigo, Succubus Rukia, Vampire Uryu, Pumpkin Orihime, Mummy Renji, Witch Rangiku, and Wolfman Hitsugaya all live as lackluster monsters.

episodes_data.title: Delusion Roars! Hisagi, Towards the Hot Springs Inn!
episodes_data.description: Shuhei Hisagi leads a busy life handling the duties of Squad 9 Lieutenant and Editor in Chief of the Seireitei Bulletin, as well as preparing picnic lunches for the Soul Reapers. One day, Hisagi and Rangiku are sent to investigate a string of disappearances in the Rukon district. But being alone together with Rangiku causes Hisagi’s imagination to go wild, which worsens when Rangiku suggests spending the night at an inn.

episodes_data.title: For the Sake of Protecting! Ichigo Vs. Tensa Zangetsu!
episodes_data.description: Aizen and Gin close in on Tatsuki, when Don Kanonji comes to the rescue. A still-injured Rangiku also arrives to confront Gin. Meanwhile, seeking to learn the Final Getsugatensho, Ichigo battles Tensa Zangetsu and Hollow Ichigo, who have now merged into one being.

episodes_data.title: Emergency Situation! Aizen, New Evolution!
episodes_data.description: Aizen continues his pursuit of Ichigo’s friends. Fearing for their lives, Keigo attempts to attack Aizen using the Zanpakuto he stole from Kurumadani. Gin returns to Aizen after having personally dealt with Rangiku, and his appearance prompts Tatsuki and the others to prepare for the worst.

episodes_data.title: Goodbye... Rangiku
episodes_data.description: Gin recalls his past and the fateful event that led him to become a Soul Reaper serving under Aizen. Meanwhile, Aizen’s overwhelming Spiritual Pressure forces Tatsuki, Keigo and the others to fall helplessly to the ground, when Ichigo finally arrives after completing his training.

episodes_data.title: Fierce Fighting Conclusion! Release, the Final Getsuga Tensho!
episodes_data.description: Battle ensues between Aizen and Ichigo. His nineties-level Kido attack easily deflected, Aizen further evolves to best Ichigo. But Ichigo, now fully aware of why Tensa Zangetsu was reluctant to teach him the Final Getsugatensho, has come to possess amazing powers.

episodes_data.title: Ichigo's Resolution! The Price of the Fierce Battle
episodes_data.description: The battle in Karakura Town and the Soul Society has come to an end. Karakura Town is returned to the World of the Living using Mayuri’s technology, and everyone prepares to return to their respective places. Ichigo is reunited with his friends who have returned from Hueco Mundo, when his condition suddenly changes.

episodes_data.title: The Soul Detective - Karakuraizer Takes Off Again!
episodes_data.description: Karakurizer is back! As Karakurizer, Kon tries to impress the ladies when a man named Michel appears. Strong, kind, handsome, and a true hero, Michel instantly gains popularity from the townspeople and the other Karakurizer. Can Karakurizer reclaim the title of No. 1 hero?! Go, Karakurizer!

episodes_data.title: Inauguration! The Brand New 2nd Division Captain!
episodes_data.description: While slacking off on his duties, Omaeda falls from a cliff. Recovering from the fall, Omaeda finds a young boy named Ryuzaburo staring at him with admiration and learns that he has unintentionally saved the boy’s life from a Hollow. When asked for his name, Omaeda lies and says he is the captain of Squad 2.

episodes_data.title: The Man Who Takes Command of the 11th Division!
episodes_data.description: While sparring with Ikkaku and Renji inside Squad 11’s dojo, Ichigo meets Seizo, whose mild-mannered personality seems out of place within the hot-blooded Squad 11. Once a powerful Soul Reaper, Seizo lost most of his spirit energy after taking a hit from a Hollow meant for Ikkaku. Ichigo, having seen Seizo’s unfair treatment within the squad, questions if he is truly content with his current life.

episodes_data.title: Secret of a Beautiful Office Lady
episodes_data.description: While Ichigo is looking into a possible Hollow incident in the World of the Living, Kon, inside Ichigo’s body, meets a beautiful woman who can see spirits. But the woman was dumped by her boyfriend because of this power and now wishes to die. Kon tries to stop the woman from killing herself when a handsome Hollow appears!

episodes_data.title: Yachiru's Friend! The Shinigami of Justice Appears!
episodes_data.description: Yachiru encounters a Soul Reaper saving a girl from a Hollow, and quickly recognizes him as Masayoshi, her old friend. As the two celebrate their reunion, Yachiru learns that “Mappy” has lost his wife to a Hollow. Since then, Masayoshi has sworn to kill all Hollows for the people of the Rukon District, and for his late wife. But something about Masayoshi’s story does not sit well with Yachiru.

episodes_data.title: Hitsugaya Toushirou's Day Off!
episodes_data.description: Hitsugaya has taken some time off and comes to Karakura Town to visit Haru, an old lady he met during a previous visit to the World of the Living. Grandma Haru introduces Hitsugaya and Karin to Yosuke, a young spirit who died before being able to experience his first snow. Hitsugaya decides to wait on performing Konso on Yosuke until the boy gets his wish, when Haru’s health suddenly worsens…

episodes_data.title: Unusual Incident in Seireitei?! Gotei 13 Invading Army Arc!
episodes_data.description: Peace has seemingly returned to both the World of the Living and the Soul Society with Aizen’s defeat. But reports of Soul Reapers going missing after entering the Precipice World begin to surface in the Soul Society. Meanwhile in the World of the Living, Kon finds an unconscious girl lying in the street and brings her home to care for, while Ichigo and Rukia discover that they are unable to contact the Soul Society.

episodes_data.title: Renji vs. Rukia?! Battle With Comrades!
episodes_data.description: Ichigo is placed under arrest by the Soul Society under suspicion of being responsible for the disappearance of the Soul Reapers in the Precipice World. With Rukia’s help, the two make an escape, when Renji and Ikkaku appear to do battle.

episodes_data.title: Ichigo's Capture Net! Escape From Soul Society!
episodes_data.description: Ichigo and Rukia find stored records on Nozomi at the Department of Research and Development, and realize the World of the Living is in danger. Hurrying to get back, the two regroup with Yoruichi, who proposes to get past the heavily guarded Senkaimon by force. Meanwhile in the World of the Living, Kon and Nozomi find themselves attacked by Kira, Nanao, and a Soul Reaper calling himself Kageroza.

episodes_data.title: Gotei 13, Gathering in the Real World!
episodes_data.description: The Thirteen Court Guard Squads who attacked Ichigo and Rukia in the Soul Society are revealed to be imposters known as Reigai, who have switched places with their originals. Thanks to the work of Mayuri, the real captains and lieutenants are rescued from the Precipice World, and they all regroup in the World of the Living to discuss how to deal with this new crisis. Meanwhile, to help Nozomi feel welcomed, Ichigo and the others decide to host a barbecue party, when Nozomi suddenly runs off.

episodes_data.title: Ikkaku vs. Ikkaku! Showdown of Mutual Self!
episodes_data.description: Kon goes out to search for Nozomi and finds her wandering aimlessly. Meanwhile, the Soul Society has assembled a special team, including the Reigai of Ikkaku, Yumichika, and Hisagi, to apprehend Ichigo. The Reigai arrive in the World of the Living where they encounter their originals, and a battle ensues!

episodes_data.title: Clash! Rukia vs. Rukia!
episodes_data.description: Rangiku faces the Reigai of Izuru, but the imposter’s Zanpakuto proves to be more powerful then she anticipated. Rukia is also having a tough battle against the Reigai of herself and Nemu, when help arrives from an unexpected person. Meanwhile in the Soul Society, Ukitake pleads for Kyoraku’s release to Central 46.

episodes_data.title: Protect Ichigo! Nozomi's Determination!
episodes_data.description: Chad encounters Renji’s Reigai while searching for Nozomi, and a battle ensues between the two. Meanwhile, Unohana grows suspicious over the events surrounding Kyoraku’s arrest, and begins to conduct her own research. In the process, Unohana learns that Kageroza is the mastermind behind this incident.

episodes_data.title: Recapture Seireitei!
episodes_data.description: The captains of the Thirteen Court Guard Squads take action to reclaim the Soul Society back from the Reigai.  As they successfully reenter the Soul Society, Kenpachi encounters his Reigai, and a fierce battle ensues. Meanwhile, Genryusai battles the Reigai of Kyoraku and Ukitake but notices something odd about their movements.

episodes_data.title: For the Sake of the Believers! Byakuya vs. Hitsugaya!
episodes_data.description: Moved by Ichigo and his friends’ efforts to protect her, Nozomi decides to stay with the group and begins to use her powers to heal Ichigo. Meanwhile in the Soul Society, Byakuya faces the Reigai of Hitsugaya.

episodes_data.title: The Two Hinamori, Hitsugaya's Resolution
episodes_data.description: Ichigo leaves for the Soul Society to join the battle, only to be ambushed by Kageroza, who intends to erase Ichigo’s existence. Back in the Soul Society, the wounded captains find themselves facing new Reigai to battle, while Hitsugaya is reunited with Hinamori.

episodes_data.title: Pride of the Kuchiki Family! Byakuya Vs. Byakuya!
episodes_data.description: Captains of the Thirteen Court Guard Squads continue their battle to reclaim the Soul Society. Head Captain Yamamoto takes on the Reigai of Kyoraku and Ukitake, but is gradually overwhelmed by the two. Meanwhile in the World of the Living, Nozomi and the others learn of Ichigo’s disappearance inside the Precipice World.

episodes_data.title: Defeat Kageroza! Shinigami, All-Out War!
episodes_data.description: Captains Hitsugaya and Kenpachi have located Kageroza and proceed to attack him, but Kageroza retaliates by controlling the Precipice World to his advantage. Back in the World of the Living, Nozomi and the others continue their search for the missing Ichigo.

episodes_data.title: The Forbidden Research... Nozomi's Hidden Secret!
episodes_data.description: Ichigo, who was swept away by the Cleaner inside the Precipice World, has safely returned to the World of the Living to everyone’s delight. Meanwhile in the Soul Society, the Reigai are revealed to be Mod Souls created by Kageroza.

episodes_data.title: I Want to Live...! Nozomi's Zanpakutou
episodes_data.description: The Soul Reapers in the World of the Living have lost contact with the captains in the Soul Society. Meanwhile, the revelation of Nozomi being a Mod Soul surprises Ichigo and his friends. Kon is particularly shocked, and is now unsure of how to interact with Nozomi.

episodes_data.title: For the Sake of Fighting! The Awakened Nozomi!
episodes_data.description: Nozomi wishes to join the battle against the Reigai, believing her Zanpakuto may stand a chance against Kageroza’s Zanpakuto. But the Soul Reapers are unable to completely trust Nozomi due to her power not being fully awakened yet. Ichigo and his friends decide to help Nozomi by training her to reach Shikai.

episodes_data.title: The Most Evil Reigai, Appearing in the Real World!
episodes_data.description: Having regained her Shikai, Nozomi tries to join Ichigo and the others to fight the Reigai captains, but the other Soul Reapers tell her not to interfere. In the midst of the battle, Hisagi and Izuru are brought down by the Reigai of Hitsugaya, who prepares to finish off the two lieutenants.

episodes_data.title: Destroy Nozomi!? Genryuusai's Decision!
episodes_data.description: Head Captain Genryusai Yamamoto steps in to battle against the Reigai. Ichigo and Nozomi join Genryusai, each taking on the Reigai of captains Unohana, Ukitake, and Kyoraku.

episodes_data.title: The Depleting Reiatsu! Ichigo, Death Struggle of the Soul!
episodes_data.description: Nozomi’s Zanpakuto breaks in the midst of trying to protect Genryusai from Kageroza’s attack. As Ichigo and Kon try to save Nozomi from being taken away, Kageroza reveals a shocking secret between him and Nozomi.

episodes_data.title: Hiding in the Dangai? Ichigo is Alone?!
episodes_data.description: Following his defeat by Kageroza, Ichigo has lost his Soul Reaper powers. Still determined to save Nozomi, Ichigo and his friends gather at Urahara’s shop to come up with a rescue plan.

episodes_data.title: Pursue Kageroza! Technological Development Department, Infiltration!
episodes_data.description: Inside the Precipice World, Rukia and the others act as decoys to draw away the Reigai’s attention while Ichigo, Urahara, and Kon break into the Seireitei. As they search for Kageroza’s laboratory, Urahara makes an attempt to restore Ichigo’s lost Soul Reaper powers but is discovered by the Reigai of Nemu and Nanao.

episodes_data.title: The Developer of the Modified Souls
episodes_data.description: The captains and lieutenants of the Thirteen Court Guard Squads thought to have fallen in battle return to fight the Reigai. Meanwhile, Ichigo’s spirit energy and Hollow powers continue to grow unstable, forcing him to rest for the time being.

episodes_data.title: Kon's Thoughts, Nozomi's Thoughts
episodes_data.description: Inside the Maggot’s Nest, Urahara and Kon find Ouko Yushima, the man behind Kageroza’s invasion. Finding traces of Kageroza’s blood nearby, the two follow the trail and finally discover Nozomi’s whereabouts.

episodes_data.title: Protect Ichigo! The Bonds of Friends!
episodes_data.description: Kageroza, having regained his complete powers, sets out to kill the Hollowfied Ichigo when Rukia, Uryu, Renji, Chad, and Orihime arrive to stop him.

episodes_data.title: Reigai Vs. Original, The Fierce Fighting for Gambled Pride!
episodes_data.description: The captains of the Thirteen Court Guard Squads find themselves gradually overpowered by the Reigai forces. Meanwhile, Rukia, Uryu, Renji and Chad use their teamwork to fight Kageroza.

episodes_data.title: Invading Army Arc, Final Conclusion!
episodes_data.description: An unexpected change comes over the Reigai as the Soul Reapers continue to fight them. Meanwhile, Ichigo and Kageroza have their final showdown.

episodes_data.title: Thank You
episodes_data.description: Returning to the World of the Living, Ichigo spends his days hunting down Hollows with what little Spirit Energy he has left. However, knowing that Ichigo cannot continue this much longer, Rukia soon realizes the time of their parting is fast approaching.

episodes_data.title: 3rd Year High School Student! Dressed up, and a New Chapter Begins!
episodes_data.description: A year has passed since Ichigo lost his Soul Reaper powers, becoming a normal teenager. Now in his final year of high school, Ichigo lives an ordinary life surrounded by his family and friends. Despite finally getting the life he always wanted, Ichigo still feels as if something is lacking, when a mysterious man appears before him.

episodes_data.title: A Dispute in School?! Ichigo and Uryuu, Fight Together!
episodes_data.description: Ichigo and Uryu deal with delinquents from another school that come looking for trouble. Following the incident, Ichigo’s boss Unagiya shows up and drags Ichigo back to the office, where he meets a man called Kugo Ginjo.

episodes_data.title: Uryu is Attacked, A Threat Draws Near the Friends!
episodes_data.description: Uryu is rushed to the hospital after being cut down by an unknown attacker. As Ichigo becomes frustrated over not being able to do anything when his friend was attacked, he learns that Keigo and Mizuro have disappeared.

episodes_data.title: The Fullbring User: Ginjou Kuugo
episodes_data.description: Unable to bear seeing his friends get attacked, Ichigo decides to call on Ginjo for some answers. At his hideout, “Xcution,” Ginjo tells Ichigo of his goal to restore Ichigo’s lost Soul Reaper powers, as well as demonstrating his own unique power, “Fullbring.”

episodes_data.title: A Creeping Danger in the Kurosaki Family?! Ichigo's Confusion!
episodes_data.description: Ginjo gives Ichigo a day to decide whether to regain his lost Soul Reaper powers or not. But Ichigo, who no longer wishes to endanger anyone by being a Soul Reaper, decides to decline the offer.

episodes_data.title: Power of the Substitute Badge, Ichigo's "Pride"!
episodes_data.description: Ichigo begins training to regain his Soul Reaper powers at the Xcution’s hideout. His first training is to fight and win against Mr. Pork, an opponent created by Riruka’s Fullbring power “Dollhouse.”

episodes_data.title: Next Target, The Devil's Hand Aims at Orihime!
episodes_data.description: On her way home from school, Orihime is suddenly stopped and asked to die by a man named Shishigawara. Confused at first, Orihime quickly realizes that Shishigawara may be related to Uryu’s attacker, and prepares to fight.

episodes_data.title: The Man Who Killed the Shinigami Substitute?! Tsukishima Makes His Move
episodes_data.description: Ichigo and Chad rush to find Orihime, who they believe may be in danger. Meanwhile, Orihime attempts to stop Tsukishima from leaving the scene, but is instead stabbed by his Fullbring power, “Book of The End.”

episodes_data.title: Fullbring, The Detested Power!
episodes_data.description: Ichigo asks Ginjo to let him fight one of the Xcution members for his training. But Jackie, who detests the power of Fullbring, finds Ichigo’s request selfish and refuses. Meanwhile, danger closes in on Chad.

episodes_data.title: Tsukishima Attacks! The Training Has Been Thwarted
episodes_data.description: Ichigo begins his training with Jackie Tristan, who brings out her Fullbring power “Dirty Boots.” As he goes up against Jackie’s powerful attacks, Ichigo begins to gradually understand the use of his own Fullbring power.

episodes_data.title: Ichigo, Mastering the Fullbring!
episodes_data.description: Tsukishima breaks into the Xcution hideout where Ichigo is training. Learning that he was the one who attacked Uryu and Orihime, a furious Ichigo proceeds to attack Tsukishima. But with his Fullbring power still incomplete, Ichigo finds himself gradually overpowered by his opponent.

episodes_data.title: Ichigo vs. Ginjou! To the Game's Space
episodes_data.description: Uryu asks Orihime to heal his injuries after sensing that his assailant has now made contact with Ichigo. Meanwhile, Ichigo enters his training with Ginjo inside Yukio’s Fulbring power “Invaders Must Die.”

episodes_data.title: The Shinigami Enter Battle! Seireitei Also Has a New Year Special!
episodes_data.description: On New Year’s Day, Izuru hosts a kite-flying contest in the hopes of everyone having a good time. Meanwhile, Rukia is practicing a dance she will perform for the New Year’s Celebration Ceremony but cannot seem to get the steps right.

episodes_data.title: Foe or Friend?! Ginjou's Unseen Heart!
episodes_data.description: Ichigo, with Orihime standing by as his healer, enters his training with Ginjo.

episodes_data.title: Creeping Menace... Tsukishima's Ability!
episodes_data.description: Orihime and Chad exchange what information they have about Tsukishima to figure out what he has done to the both of them.

episodes_data.title: Clash?! Xcution Attacks Ginjou
episodes_data.description: Uryu begins his own investigation to track down the enemy who attacked him. As he goes around searching for clues, he notices that people close to Ichigo are acting strangely. Meanwhile, Ichigo’s Fullbring training is nearing its completion.

episodes_data.title: The Sorrowful Battle! Ichigo vs. Sado & Orihime!
episodes_data.description: Ichigo escapes from his house in confusion after witnessing his friends and family welcoming Tsukishima as if they’ve known him for years. Regrouping with Ginjo, Ichigo learns that the same change has also happened to Riruka and the other Xcution members.

episodes_data.title: Ichigo vs. Uryuu?! Who is the Traitor?!
episodes_data.description: Ichigo is shocked to learn that Chad and Orihime have now sided with Tsukishima and are even willing to fight Ichigo to protect their precious “friend.” Meanwhile, Ginjo races to help Ichigo, but the remaining members of Xcution halt his attempt.

episodes_data.title: A New Appearance! Meet the Gotei 13!
episodes_data.description: Ginjo reveals his true colors by attacking Ichigo and stripping him of his Fullbring powers. Ichigo lies in despair from losing his powers yet again, when his father Isshin and Kisuke Urahara arrive.

episodes_data.title: Revival! Substitute Shinigami - Ichigo Kurosaki!
episodes_data.description: Under the orders of Head Captain Yamamoto, the 13 Court Guard Squad Soul Reapers share their Spirit Energy to restore Ichigo’s lost powers. With his Soul Reaper powers fully restored, Ichigo returns to challenge Ginjo.

episodes_data.title: Fierce Fight! Shinigami vs. XCUTION!
episodes_data.description: The Soul Reapers take on the Xcution members in one-on-one battles. Meanwhile, Ichigo and Uryu prepare to take on Ginjo.

episodes_data.title: Desperate Struggle!? Byakuya's Troubled Memories
episodes_data.description: The battle between Byakuya and Tsukishima escalates as they both push their powers to the limit. Meanwhile, Rukia struggles against the cute traps set up by Riruka.

episodes_data.title: Ichigo vs. Ginjou! The Secret of the Substitute Badge
episodes_data.description: While facing each other in battle, Uryu notices that Ginjo’s attack contains the presence of Ichigo’s Spirit Energy. Ignoring Uryu’s warning, Ichigo fires his Getsugatensho attack, only to be countered by Ginjo’s own Getsugatensho attack.

episodes_data.title: Changing History, Unchanging Heart
episodes_data.description: Ichigo and Ginjo both release their Bankai to settle the score once and for all.
